Open Xcode > Settings > Accounts, click +, choose Apple Account, and authenticate.
Use the same Apple Account that owns the test devices when practical.
Select the Apple Account and confirm a team labeled '(Personal Team)' appears.

Apple currently limits it to 10 App IDs, 3 devices, and 3 installed apps per device; assets expire after 7 days.

Do not mark capability tests Pass when an entitlement was removed.

A valid local development signing identity exists.
Do not export or commit its private key.
Inspect the effective build settings and confirm the Personal Team build uses loopback/mock development data, not production.
NAASEH_ENABLE_PRODUCTION_DATA is NO and no production session is embedded.
Stop immediately if a development build reaches production.
Run npm run apple:test, npm run apple:build:ios, and npm run apple:build:macos.
Package tests and both unsigned builds pass.
Add a calendar reminder to rebuild/reinstall Personal Team apps every 7 days while testing.
Expired profiles do not surprise the test schedule.
The free profile and registered assets expire periodically.
Confirm no .mobileprovision, .p12, API key, password, team identifier, or secret xcconfig was added to git.
git status shows no signing secrets.
If exposed, revoke the credential and remove it from history before continuing.
Run the Personal Team installation on both iPhone and iPad and launch the Mac app outside Xcode.
All free-capability device tests can begin.
Paid capability failures remain explicitly Blocked, not waived.
